samples.xml_description:
<module id="multi_8bit">
    <description>Implement an 8-bit multiplier based on shifting and adding operations.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="A" width_description="[7:0]">First 8-bit input operand (multiplicand).</input>
        <input id="B" width_description="[7:0]">Second 8-bit input operand (multiplier).</input>
        <output id="product" width_description="[15:0]">16-bit output representing the product of A and B.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="N" value="8">Parameter N represents the number of bits for inputs A and B.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="combinational_logic">
        <line>Initialize the product to zero.</line>
        <line>For each bit in the multiplier (B):</line>
        <line>- If the bit is 1, add the multiplicand (A) to the product.</line>
        <line>- Shift the multiplicand (A) left by one position.</line>
        <line>- Shift the product right by one position.</line>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        <line>Initialize product to zero.</line>
        <line>for (i = 0; i < N; i++) {</line>
        <line>  if (B[i] == 1) {</line>
        <line>    product = product + A;</line>
        <line>  }</line>
        <line>  A = A << 1;</line>
        <line>  product = product >> 1;</line>
        <line>}</line>
    </implementation>
</module>
